def make_case(h,w,bg,bcol,bar1,bar2,seedcol,seeds,orientation='h'):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if orientation=='h':
        r1,s1,e1=bar1; r2,s2,e2=bar2
        for c in range(s1,e1+1):g[r1][c]=bcol
        for c in range(s2,e2+1):g[r2][c]=bcol
    else:
        c1,s1,e1=bar1; c2,s2,e2=bar2
        for r in range(s1,e1+1):g[r][c1]=bcol
        for r in range(s2,e2+1):g[r][c2]=bcol
    for r,c in seeds:g[r][c]=seedcol
    return g
def expected_case(h,w,bg,bcol,bar1,bar2,seedcol,seeds,src,orientation='h'):
    g=make_case(h,w,bg,bcol,bar1,bar2,seedcol,seeds,orientation); o=[r[:] for r in g]

        e1,s1,_=bar1; e2,s2,_=bar2
        source=(e1,s1) if src==0 else (e2,s2); target=(e2,s2) if src==0 else (e1,s1)

            m=c+target[1]-source[1]

            step=1 if source[0]<c else -1

def expected_case2(h,w,bg,bcol,bar1,bar2,seedcol,seeds,src,orientation='h'):
    g=make_case(h,w,bg,bcol,bar1,bar2,seedcol,seeds,orientation); o=[r[:] for r in g]
    if orientation=='h':
        e1,s1,_=bar1; e2,s2,_=bar2
        source=(e1,s1) if src==0 else (e2,s2); target=(e2,s2) if src==0 else (e1,s1)
        for r,c in seeds:
            mapped=c+target[1]-source[1]
            for rr in range(h):
                if g[rr][mapped] != bcol:o[rr][mapped]=seedcol
            step=1 if source[0]<r else -1
            for rr in range(source[0]+step,r,step):o[rr][c]=seedcol
            o[r][c]=4
    else:
        e1,s1,_=bar1; e2,s2,_=bar2
        source=(e1,s1) if src==0 else (e2,s2); target=(e2,s2) if src==0 else (e1,s1)
        for r,c in seeds:
            mapped=r+target[1]-source[1]
            for cc in range(w):
                if g[mapped][cc] != bcol:o[mapped][cc]=seedcol
            step=1 if source[0]<c else -1
            for cc in range(source[0]+step,c,step):o[r][cc]=seedcol
            o[r][c]=4
    return g,o
